title: Create a pipeline and edit its stages

steps.do: Left menu → Sales → Pipelines & funnels → "Create one": Name "Export deals", What is it for = Opportunity funnel, Start from = a plain four-stage, tick "Make it the default for new work" → "Create it".
steps.expect: Listed with its stages; Default = yes; the previous default is no longer default.
steps.observed: Listed: "Export deals 4 0 Default Active Edit stages"; the previous default "Inspection, testing & certification — new business" now offers "Make default".

steps.do: "Edit stages": rename a stage, set Probability 30 and Days allowed 14 → Save.
steps.expect: Saved; deals on that stage keep their place.
steps.observed: "" — stage renamed "First contact", 30%, 14 days; the deal on it stays there (its page now reads "First contact").

steps.do: "Add a stage": Name "Technical clarification", What it means = Still in play, Probability 40, Days allowed 7 → "Add it".
steps.expect: Added at the end; order can be changed.
steps.observed: Added at the end; the order can be changed.

steps.expect: Refused or capped — record what happens.
steps.observed: Typing 150: the browser refuses to send it ("Value must be less than or equal to 100."), stays 30%. Sent anyway: 150 is stored as 100% ("Saved."); −10 is stored as 0%.

steps.do: Remove a stage that has deals on it.
steps.expect: Refused or the deals are protected — record what happens; deals must never vanish.
steps.observed: The stage with the deal shows "has records" instead of Remove (untick "in use" to retire it); a re-sent remove form → "1 record is sitting on “First contact”. Move them to another stage first, or untick it to "; stage kept, deal still there on stage 31.

steps.do: Two stages both "Won — closes the deal".
steps.observed: Set "Technical clarification" to "Won — closes the deal" beside the existing Won stage and saved: "Saved.". Won stages now: Won (100%), Technical clarification (100%).
steps.reason: The test asks to record what happens with two Won stages.
steps.proposed: Refuse a second "Won" (and a second "Lost") stage in one funnel with a sentence — a deal moved to "Won" must land on one stage, and the dashboard's won count should not split across two.

steps.do: As Test MktExec: open Pipelines & funnels.
steps.expect: Can view; cannot edit (pipe_can = company setup).
steps.observed: Opens for viewing; no "Create one", stage boxes disabled, no Save; a re-sent save → "You cannot change the pipelines." (name unchanged).
